attrition.label: Attrition
attrition.blurb: One party through all eight rooms; wounds carry on, with a breather between rooms and a camp (a long rest) after room 4. The run ends at the first room the party can't win.

reset.label: Reset
reset.blurb: A fresh, full-strength party for every room, the dead restored. Every room is fought in every run; deaths are recorded room by room.
